thread:
Nora: quick sync  we're targeting Wednesday for the pricing page microlaunch. main deliverables: FAQ copy, calculator tweaks, tier names, and a short webinar promo. who can own final QA?
Evan: I can run through the calculator edge cases. please share the finalized pricing rules (quantized vs full precision, cache addon).
Carla: copy side: I wrote short FAQ stubs for three items: billing cadence, model pinning, and data residency. dropping them below.
Carla: FAQ stubs:
- Billing cadence: "Invoices are monthly by default; annual billing available for reserved capacity."
- Model pinning: "You can pin a model version for stable output; pinning may alter your unit cost."
- Data residency: "Hosted API stores infer logs in region unless private deployment is selected."
Ben: on tier names, my vote is for descriptive but concise. proposed: "Core, Scale, Enterprise+". keeps it short on mobile.
Mei: analytics: make sure the calculator submit event includes `experiment_arm` and `hero_headline` for the A/B. I'll add `utm_source=pricing_widget` to outbound leads.
Nora: thanks. also want a microcopy tweak on the simulator: change "estimated monthly spend" to "projected monthly cost" to lower friction. please update.
Evan: will adjust math to reflect quantization discount. note: quantized models get a 30% multiplier by default unless user chooses 8-bit fast mode (40%). I'll add a tooltip.
Carla: webinar blurb (for widget): "Live demo: how we tune inference for cost and latency. Thu 11am PT. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_campaign=pricing_widget"
marketing-bot: preview build: https://app.internal/previews/pricing-sim/v2 (expires 24h)
Ben: spot-checked preview: hero CTA links to old webinar URL. updating CTA to Carla's link. also saw a layout issue on iPad where the calculator panel overflows. tagging @Evan.
Evan: fixed overflow, pushed v3 preview. also corrected quantization multiplier bug where cache option negated discount. regenerated preview.
Mei: routed leads mapping: all calculator submits go to `pricing-inbound`; set `lead_priority` to high if `projected_mrr >= 7500`. also creating a Looker tile for daily counts per variant.
Carla: added FAQ copy into the doc and marked the model-pinning Q as "staged". also wrote short microcopy variants for the hero line (3 options).
Nora: A/B test plan: hero A = value-led line, hero B = capacity-led line. run for 72 hours, primary metric: simulator submit rate, secondary: webinar signups.
Ben: small ask: marketing-bot can we auto-post the final preview link once v3 deploy completes? need clean screenshots for launch thread.
marketing-bot: will post updated preview URL when pipeline finishes.
Evan: deploy completed at 09:14. preview: https://app.internal/previews/pricing-sim/v3. QA done: quantization math and tooltip verified.
Mei: analytics events confirmed: `pricing_widget_submit` with props ["experiment_arm","projected_mrr","addons","quantized"]. dashboard tile created.
Nora: excellent. timeline: go/no-go 14:00 today after final copy pass. Carla please finalize hero microcopy and confirm which variants map to experiment arms.
Carla: done. mapping posted to shared sheet and comments added. leaving the webinar CTA as optional in control arm.
Ben: routing updated. will notify Sales ops if any high-priority lead shows.
Nora: thanks team  we're green to proceed pending copy signoff.
